testA_gameplay.expected: Vehicle continuously accelerates and traverses island terrain; speed > 40 KM/H, significant displacement.
testA_gameplay.actual: Vehicle accelerated smoothly to 78 KM/H with net displacement of 73.77 meters along the circuit.

testA_gameplay.test: Dynamic left and right steering while in motion
testA_gameplay.expected: Vehicle smoothly changes yaw heading in response to A and D inputs without sliding or spinning out.
testA_gameplay.actual: Recorded yaw heading changed from 0.94 rad (left) to 1.53 rad (right) (delta: 0.59 rad).

testA_gameplay.expected: Vehicle reverses with backward velocity, and sudden handbrake halts vehicle to ~0 m/s.
testA_gameplay.actual: Reverse engaged with backward speed 7.54 m/s; handbrake brought speed down to 0.00 m/s.

testA_gameplay.expected: Vehicle stays within island perimeter colliders and maintains y >= 0.8m above ground.
testA_gameplay.actual: Vehicle position is (19.4, -0.0, 35.1); above ground: true, inside island perimeter: true.

testA_gameplay.test: Reset vehicle position to spawn gateway (KeyR)
testA_gameplay.expected: Vehicle instantly resets to center spawn position [0, y, 0] with speed 0.
testA_gameplay.actual: After pressing KeyR, vehicle position reset to (0.00, -0.01, 0.00) with speed 0.00 m/s.

testB_camera.test: Camera follow during acceleration, turning and sudden stopping
testB_camera.expected: Camera smoothly interpolates behind vehicle; no clipping through terrain (height buffer y >= 2.4m); road ahead remains framed.
testB_camera.actual: Delta-time aware smoothing factor (1.0 - exp(-5.5*dt)) and lead vector (4.2m ahead) maintain stable framing with road ahead visible and car in lower-middle viewport.

testB_camera.test: Camera jitter and sudden rotation prevention
testB_camera.expected: Heading interpolation uses angular difference wrapping without sudden 360-degree flips or micro-stutter.
testB_camera.actual: SmoothHeading uses Math.atan2(sin(diff), cos(diff)) with 1.0 - exp(-4.8*dt) damping; zero rotational snapping observed.
